mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prescription (prescription_no, medical_record_id, patient_id, doctor_id, status, review_comment, prescription_type, herbal_doses, herbal_usage, create_time) VALUES (#{prescriptionNo}, #{medicalRecordId}, #{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{status}, #{reviewComment}, #{prescriptionType}, #{herbalDoses}, #{herbalUsage}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM prescription WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY create_time DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prescription WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
SELECT * FROM prescription WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND pay_status = 'UNPAID' ORDER BY create_time DESC
